s24_new_findings.class: census --compare is NUL-blind: a NUL-forged baseline forges an all-clear
s24_new_findings.severity: contract-violation (false no-diff; no deletion path involved)
s24_new_findings.observed: A prior census with a NUL byte spliced into a repo name (alpha-sh\0okunin) or into a numeric field value (dirty=0\0) compares as 'no diff' rc=0 against a fleet whose real key/field differs. Control: the same baseline with the NUL removed reports the real diff rc=3. A NUL suffix after the repo name splits one repo into two keys ('...alpha-shokunin' ADDED + '...alpha-shokuninx' REMOVED) — still rc=0, still a forged diff shape.
s24_new_findings.root_cause: bash `read`/`${var%%\t*}`/parameter expansion silently truncate at NUL, so load_census's exact-header comparison and the repo-key/field splitting never see the forged suffix; NUL bytes pass the existing header equality check byte-truncated.
s24_new_findings.reproduction: fixture /var/tmp/s24-nul2-HeEcER: gen1 census -> splice NUL -> compare rc=0 (bug); NUL removed -> rc=3 (control). One-liner: python3 -c 'data=open(p,"rb").read(); open(q,"wb").write(data.replace(b"alpha-shokunin", b"alpha-sh\\x00okunin",1))' then souji-census.sh --root FLEET --compare q
s24_new_findings.uniqueness: no r11 fragment covers NUL in the compare baseline (cert-09/11/12/13/14/15/16, final-28/29/31, seat-08/23/25 checked; their only NUL mentions are the unrelated quarantine --list NUL-pin class J16)
s24_new_findings.fix_direction: reject any prior file containing a NUL byte (grep -q $'\0' or LC_ALL=C grep -c $'\x00') before parsing, exit 2; mirrors the quarantine --list NUL rejection already shipped

s24_new_findings.class: census --compare silently mis-parses short rows (fewer than 6 data fields)
s24_new_findings.observed: A data row with only 2 fields ('<repo>\t0\t0') under a valid header parses as worktrees=0, unpushed=0, dirty=0, scratch_bytes=0, mtime_iso=0, verdict_flags=0 — field_at() returns the last present field for every missing index, so fields 3-6 all read '0'. The compare then reports the real fleet state as a diff against forged zeros (rc=3, wrong diff) instead of refusing the malformed baseline (rc=2). A row with an empty repo name IS refused (rc=2) — the asymmetry shows short-row validation was simply never written.
s24_new_findings.reproduction: fixture /var/tmp/s24-genb-mMUa8G/short-row2gA.tsv vs /var/tmp/s24-genb2-YRpKF7/fleet on all four generations: rc=3 with forged-field diff rows
s24_new_findings.uniqueness: no r11 fragment covers short-row mis-parse
s24_new_findings.fix_direction: validate field count per row in load_census (require exactly 6 tab-separated data fields after the repo key; else usage_err exit 2)
